title: SKILL.md Frontmatter Schema
description: Canonical YAML frontmatter contract for a Ship smart skill (SKILL.md). Enforced by the runtime skill loader. The fields here are the only fields a committed SKILL.md may carry; unknown fields are rejected so that the contract is monitorable.

name.description: Skill id. Kebab-case; must equal the containing directory name (e.g. docs/ship-triggers/SKILL.md => name: ship-triggers).

stable-id.description: Stable storage key for variable state. Survives directory renames. By convention equals `name` unless the skill has been renamed.

description.description: One-sentence purpose. Start with 'Use when...' for reliable trigger matching.

tags.description: Category labels. Lowercase kebab strings. At least one tag is required so skills surface in discovery.

authors.description: Skill authors. Free-form strings, but the array must not be empty.

audience.description: Visibility. `public` (default) ships in published docs. `internal` is excluded from the docs collector. `agent-only` is loaded by agents but never published.

version.description: Optional semver-ish version string. Absent means unversioned/rolling.

supersedes.description: Stable-id of the skill this one replaces.

superseded-by.description: Stable-id of the skill that replaces this one.

compatibility.description: Comma-separated provider names this skill is compatible with. Omit for universal compatibility.

allowed-tools.description: MCP tool names the skill requires. Space-delimited in YAML, array in JSON.

artifacts.description: Artifact types this skill produces. The platform infers rendering and interaction capabilities from these types.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value string metadata. Reserved keys: `display_name`, `source`.
